intro: Azerbaijan has about 10 million people, mostly Azerbaijanis, a Turkic people.

chapters.title: People
text: Azerbaijani is a Turkic language close to Turkish. Most people are Shia Muslims, though the state is secular. There are Lezgin, Talysh and Russian minorities.
Many more ethnic Azerbaijanis live in northern Iran.

chapters.title: Baku
text: Baku is home to about a quarter of the population, with a walled old city next to modern towers.

keyTerms.meaning: A family of languages including Turkish, Azerbaijani and Kazakh.
